SDPDF.Done: PDF character sheet for {name} is downloading.
SDPDF.Error: Failed to generate the PDF character sheet. See the console (F12) for details.
SDPDF.UnsupportedCharacters: No available font can display these characters, so they were left out of the PDF: {characters}. You can point the module at a font that covers them in the module settings.
SDPDF.CustomFontFailed: The font at {path} could not be loaded, so the bundled font was used instead. Check the path in the module settings.
SDPDF.Settings.WorldPath2024.Name: 2024 official sheet for all players
SDPDF.Settings.WorldPath2014.Name: 2014 official sheet for all players
SDPDF.Settings.WorldPath.Hint: Optional. A copy of this official sheet, uploaded to Foundry, that anyone without their own copy will use. Players who lack the "Use File Browser" permission (by default, anyone below Trusted Player) cannot pick a sheet themselves, so set this for them. A player who has picked their own copy keeps using it.
SDPDF.Settings.CustomFont.Name: Font for non-Latin text
SDPDF.Settings.CustomFont.Hint: Only needed for alphabets the bundled PT Sans does not cover, such as Greek, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese or Korean. Leave empty unless characters are missing from your exported sheets. Must be a .ttf or .otf file; headings will render in the regular weight.
SDPDF.Export.Title: Export Character Sheet
SDPDF.Export.HeroSub: Pick a layout to export a filled sheet for {name}.
SDPDF.Export.Desc2024: The official Wizards of the Coast 2024 sheet. Copyrighted, so you point the module at your own copy.
SDPDF.Export.Desc2014: The official Wizards of the Coast 2014 sheet. Copyrighted, so you point the module at your own copy.
SDPDF.Export.NotProvided: This official sheet is copyrighted and cannot be bundled with the module. Download your own copy, upload it to Foundry, then browse to it here.
SDPDF.Export.NoBrowse: This official sheet is copyrighted and cannot be bundled with the module, and you don't have permission to pick a file in Foundry. Ask your GM to set this sheet in the module settings, or to give you the "Use File Browser" permission.
SDPDF.Export.MissingOfficial: That official sheet has not been provided yet. Use the export dialog to download and select it first.
SDPDF.Export.AskGM: The official sheet for this layout is missing or could not be used. Ask your GM to check the file set for it in the module settings.
SDPDF.Export.TemplateUnavailable: The PDF you selected could not be loaded from {path}. It may have been moved, renamed or deleted — upload it again and use "Change" in the export dialog to re-select it.
SDPDF.Export.TemplateMismatch: The file selected for the {layout} ({path}) is not that fillable PDF, so it cannot be filled in. Download the official PDF using the link in the export dialog — saving the file itself rather than printing it to PDF — then use "Change" to select it.
